methods.description: List all factors of each positive whole number using the taught factor-listing prerequisite, identify values appearing in both lists and select the greatest. When the smaller input divides the larger, it is the HCF; when only1is shared, the HCF is1. These are contrasts within the same procedure, not additional algorithms.
